title: Declared source-to-destination mapping with tolerance
statement: Converting a time from a source domain to a destination domain must require a declared mapping carrying source, destination, and maximum admissible tolerance; a missing mapping or a tolerance failure must return distinct deterministic results.

source.reference: packet.md (maps between domains only under declared source, destination, and tolerance rules); interface-bridge.md; anchors: XVE-SYS-0147, FR-015

applicability: xverse::xcom::validation time authority mapping table; finite host-configurable bound.
verification_intent: Unit: declared mapping inside, at, and beyond tolerance; reverse-direction request; undeclared pair; assert distinct outcomes and no mutation.
acceptance_criteria: A declared mapping converts within tolerance and reports the destination domain.
An undeclared source-to-destination pair yields a distinct MissingMapping result.
A conversion beyond the declared tolerance yields a distinct tolerance-failure result.
Mappings are directional: a declared A-to-B mapping does not silently enable B-to-A.
